description: Inspect PE/CLI metadata members, signatures, raw CIL hashes, decoded-instruction-tuple hashes, separately reported exception regions, call edges, field-access anchors, and the #US string literals that ldstr loads, without loading or executing target code. Select type_names to decode only the members of those exact declaring types and the literals their bodies load, which keeps large assemblies such as a base class library within the representation budget. Metadata tokens are reported as build-local coordinates bound to the artifact SHA-256 and MVID; the tuple hash does not resolve them or fully commit control flow. Omitted or complete detail returns every collection, including the assembly-wide member_refs and exported_types, which type_names does not narrow. Select detail: "summary" for identity, metadata status, selection with unmatched names, coverage/issues, limitations and per-collection counts; it retains complete Evidence and returns a linked inspect_analysis_view summary. Page original rows with view kind managed-members, normalized_result.parent_evidence_id and collection types/exported_types/fields/methods/member_refs/call_edges/field_accesses/user_strings.

__schema0.description: Explicit absolute managed PE/CLI path; omit to reuse the previously selected managed target

__schema2.description: Inspect only the fields, methods, call edges, and field accesses declared by these exact type full names, and the user strings their method bodies load; omit to inspect every type. Unmatched names are reported in selection.unmatched_type_names.

__schema3.description: Exact declaring-type full_name: namespace-qualified for top-level types (System.Threading.Monitor); nested types report their bare name, so it selects every nested type of that name

path.description: Explicit absolute managed PE/CLI path; omit to reuse the previously selected managed target

type_names.description: Inspect only the fields, methods, call edges, and field accesses declared by these exact type full names, and the user strings their method bodies load; omit to inspect every type. Unmatched names are reported in selection.unmatched_type_names.

name: inspect_managed_members

target_declaring_type.description: Declaring type of the called method; null when unknown

target_name.description: Method name; a method-spec target reports its generic method

field_declaring_type.description: Declaring type of the accessed field; null when unknown

parent_name.description: Name of a TypeDef, TypeRef, or generic-instantiation TypeSpec parent; null for other parents or when unknown

il_sha256.description: SHA-256 of exactly the raw il_size CIL bytes; excludes the method header, locals signature, alignment, and extra sections

normalized_il_sha256.description: Member-result-v1 SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON [opcode, operand_kind, operand] tuples for a complete decode; retains build-local tokens, omits switch targets, and excludes headers, locals, and exception regions

value.description: Decoded UTF-16 code units, excluding the terminal flag byte; unpaired surrogates are kept

path.description: Exact recorded artifact path, including an empty string.

title: Inspect Managed Members
